title: MASHUP (performance repeats and effects on the trig keys, FUNC + SAMPLING)
author: Robbie
description: MASHUP (formerly STUTTER) for the Digitakt mk1 (OS 1.54): an always-on buffer of the master mix, before GESTALT, played back quantised. FUNC + SAMPLING turns MASHUP mode on and off (a pop-up says which; SAMPLING lights purple and each trig key shows its colour, with the sequencer step moving across them). In the mode, on the normal screen: 9-14 repeat the last 1/2 bar, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 or 1/8 triplet; 15 REV; 16 HALF (alone: HALF-TIME, in time); 15 alone: each beat backwards, in time; 1 SCRAMBLE, 2 SCRAMBLE 1/8, 3 SCRAMBLE + REV, 4 SCRAMBLE MIX, 5 PITCH down, 6 PITCH up, 7 ROLL, 8 BACKSPIN. Changes land on the next 16th; each press names itself on the top line. SAMPLING + a trig key latches it; the key again, or SAMPLING alone, unlatches. Pattern and bank selection, grid recording and keyboard mode keep their stock keys and lights. Mode off: every key is stock. 5.4 s of stereo in the recorder RAM: MASHUP pauses while the recorder is armed or recording, and overwrites a take left on the RECORDER page.

names: keys:trig 1-16 on the normal screen in MASHUP mode
leds:trig keys and SAMPLING in MASHUP mode
knobs:A-H while a MASHUP key or SAMPLING is held in MASHUP mode
